summary.text: KONNERUDGATA ALLTID AS is a private limited company registered in Drammen, founded 2021-05-31. KONNERUDGATA ALLTID AS erverver, eier og utvikler fast eiendom samt fritidseiendom, og kan forestå utleie, bortfeste og salg av egne eiendommer. Selskapets formål er drift av dagligvarebutikk og alt som står i forbindelse med dette, herunder å delta i andre selskaper med lignende virksomhet. It was previously named AA EIENDOM INVEST AS until 2022-09-06. Its main industry code is 47.110: non-specialised retail sale of predominately food, beverages or tobacco. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 26 640 208 NOK and the annual result was 2 413 233 NOK; operating income was up from 24 333 174 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 2 535 950 NOK in 2024 to 2 413 233 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 2 505 822 NOK in 2024 to 4 169 055 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Mohammad Ali Ahmed (daglig leder and styrets leder). The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-13 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
